question: In its answer to my question E-003368/20251, the Commission wrote: ‘Regarding the alleged contradiction mentioned in the question, the Commission would like to point out that the assessment under EU State aid law is a separate matter from contacts in relation to national audits, which were the contacts referred to in the written reply by Commissioner Hadja Lahbib to Question P-002657/20252.’ 1.

As part of the assessment under EU State aid law in Case SA.104638 (procurement of masks through logistics company FIEGE), with which German authorities, ministries or other public bodies did the Commission have contact and when?
What did this contact consist of?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (7.11.2025) As part of State aid procedures, the Commission contacts the authorities of the Member State concerned by the procedure. Any information exchanged between the Commission and the Member State in the context of State aid procedures is primarily channelled through the Permanent Representation of the respective Member State.
